name: Psionic Power List (other Publishers)
body:
Technological Psionic Powers

The following new psionic powers interface with technology and/or with sci-fi themes, tropes, and abilities in what they allow PCs to accomplish with the power of their minds.

Cryptic Powers
1st-Level
Power Name	Description	Source
Environment Shield	Insulate target against hostile environmental effects	A:TE
Malfunction	Cause technological equipment to glitch	A:TE
Transfer Energy	Move charges from one technological device to another	A:TE
2nd-Level
Power Name	Description	Source
Holographic Projection	Fabricate ectoplasmic holograms	A:TE
Psionic Recharge	Grant charge to technological item	A:TE
3rd-Level
Power Name	Description	Source
Id Autopilot	Control a vehicle or mech through psychokinesis	A:TE
Reconfiguration	Alter the functionalities of a mech or vehicle	A:TE
Short Circuit	Disrupt function of technological equipment	A:TE
5th-Level
Power Name	Description	Source
Coded Resurrection	Return deceased soul to life as AI	A:TE
6th-Level
Power Name	Description	Source
Data Transfer	Move AI from one host form to another	A:TE
